notes.title: New update Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44350755/e398cd06d95803a3e29d197836d2da8c8f515bdc.png[/img]

[b]Updated voice acting[/b] - we managed to find an amazing voice acting that will not only complement the character, but also make the player feel all that gravity of the situation and atmosphereъ

[b]Optimization[/b] - thanks to your Feedback, we have learned a lot of things to optimize both in code and visually, now it will be even better to play))

[b]New enemy[/b] - a new mysterious creature with which you have to face one on one

[b]Improved graphics[/b] - for those who love a beautiful picture, we tried to improve what was and add many other graphic elements so that you still plunge deeper into this atmosphere

[b]Bugs fixed [/b]- thanks to your Feedback, we were able to fix the bugs that caused you discomfort

we will not stop at this will do everything better and better
 wait for more news)) I will be grateful for the feedback in the discussions
